zh.title: 聯合航空接收首批空中巴士A321XLR客機
zh.summary: 聯合航空迎接空中巴士A321XLR交付；推動航網戰略與拓展計劃
body: 聯合航空（United Airlines）已迎來空中巴士（Airbus）A321XLR 客機，成為最新引進該款機型的航空公司。這批空中巴士 A321XLR 客機的交付，象徵著該公司機隊發展邁入全新階段。
空中巴士 A321XLR 客機的加入與聯合航空未來的航網戰略及拓展計劃密切相關。航空公司正透過引進該型客機，為未來的航線部署與營運網絡規劃奠定基礎。
隨著首批客機完成交付，聯合航空預計將持續評估並調整其整體網路戰略，以配合未來的業務擴展需求。

en.title: United Airlines Welcomes Airbus A321XLR Aircraft to Fleet
en.summary: United Airlines welcomes its first Airbus A321XLR aircraft to support future network expansion plans.
body: United Airlines has officially become the latest airline to welcome the Airbus A321XLR aircraft into its passenger fleet. The initial deliveries of the single-aisle aircraft mark an important milestone in the carrier's ongoing fleet development and operational growth.

The arrival of the Airbus A321XLR is directly tied to United Airlines' future network strategy and long-term route expansion plans. The airline intends to utilize the aircraft type to strengthen its overall network connectivity and support prospective international and domestic market expansion.
With the aircraft now joining the fleet, United Airlines continues to evaluate its network alignment and operational deployment strategies to support future commercial objectives.
